# ferriskey_client_saml_config (Resource)

Manages the SAML service-provider configuration of a FerrisKey client (one per client, the client must use the `saml` protocol). The API stores the whole configuration on every write, so omitted optional attributes fall back to their defaults. The API has no delete endpoint for this configuration: destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform state and leaves the configuration in place on the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_client_saml_config" "example" {
  realm          = "acme"
  client_uuid    = ferriskey_client.saml.client_uuid
  sp_entity_id   = "urn:example:sp"
  acs_url        = "https://sp.example.com/saml/acs"
  name_id_format = "urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent"
  sign_documents = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `acs_url` (String) Assertion Consumer Service URL of the service provider (absolute `http` or `https` URL).
- `client_uuid` (String) UUID of the SAML client (`ferriskey_client.<name>.client_uuid`). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm owning the client. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `sp_entity_id` (String) Entity ID of the service provider (an absolute URI such as `urn:example:sp` or a URL).

### Optional

- `name_id_format` (String) SAML NameID format URN. One of `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress` (default), `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent`, `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient` or `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified`.
- `sign_assertions` (Boolean) Whether SAML assertions are signed. Defaults to `true`.
- `sign_documents` (Boolean) Whether whole SAML response documents are signed. Defaults to `false`.
- `want_authn_requests_signed` (Boolean) Whether the service provider is required to sign its authentication requests. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form `{realm}/{client_uuid}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by {realm}/{client_uuid}.
terraform import ferriskey_client_saml_config.example acme/3a8c6128-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
